subject.title: fix(net-policy): preserve repeated secret query params

question: Should this PR preserve git managed-repo cache identity before merge, or may maintainers accept duplicate-secret git specs being treated as fresh installs after upgrade?
rationale: Repository policy treats upgrade-affecting cache/default identity changes as compatibility-sensitive, and only a maintainer can intentionally accept that drift instead of requiring a repair.

options.title: Preserve Cache Identity
options.body: Require the PR to decouple display redaction from the git managed-repo key, or add migration/back-compat coverage before merge.

options.title: Accept Rare Drift
options.body: Allow duplicate-secret git specs to re-clone or behave like fresh installs after upgrade, with maintainer-visible acceptance of that compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Preserve Cache Identity
recommendation.body: Require the PR to decouple display redaction from the git managed-repo key, or add migration/back-compat coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily affects the git install cache identity path introduced with the git/local source install work.
